北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -4℃，记得多穿点，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and cold, feels like -4℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴好，微风宜人，出门记得添衣，小心着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and pleasant. Mind the breeze, stay cozy!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗温暖，体感舒适。出门散步，心情一定很好！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and mild. Perfect weather for a walk!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，体感 18℃，温暖舒适。别忘了补水！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and sunny, feels like 18℃. Stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗宜人，体感 15℃，早晚温差大，注意添衣。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant, feels like 15℃. Watch for temperature changes!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光明媚，体感 13℃，舒适好天气，出门走走吧！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and pleasant, feels like 13℃. Enjoy the beautiful day!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，体感 10℃，记得带件外套，以免着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 10℃. Remember your jacket, stay warm.
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阳光露脸，体感 8℃。早晚温差大，记得加衣哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and cool, feels like 8℃. Mind the temperature changes!
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴好，体感 9℃。湿度较高，出门记得带伞哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and cool, feels like 9℃. With high humidity, stay prepared!
武汉.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 7℃。空气干燥，记得多喝水、润肤哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and cool, feels like 7℃. It's very dry, stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多霾，体感 11℃。空气质量不佳，出门记得戴口罩！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is hazy, feels like 11℃. Air quality is low, wear a mask outside!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴冷，体感 -29℃！务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and extremely cold, feels like -29℃! Bundle up, protect from frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -29℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 -8℃。多穿几层，暖和最重要！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and cold, feels like -8℃. Layer up, stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and mild, feels like 10℃. Mind the temperature changes!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴暖，体感 14℃。阳光正好，出门散心吧！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and warm, feels like 14℃. Enjoy the lovely day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾弥漫，体感 2℃。能见度低，出行请注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels like 2℃. Low visibility, please stay safe when traveling!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连大雾，体感 0℃。路面湿滑，小心慢行，注意保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy, feels like 0℃. Roads might be slippery, please walk carefully and stay warm!
